content.text: [Feishu Group #contract-review kevin.zhao CFO Fri Jan 18 10:00 UTC 2026] CISG is clearly excluded per §12.3. The 12-month liability cap is fine — it aligns with our Year 1 payments (~$480K). No exposure concerns.
Noted: CFO (Kevin Zhao) confirms §12.3 CISG exclusion and accepts 12-month cap.

[Feishu Group #contract-review IT.team Fri Jan 18 10:30 UTC 2026] Hold — VendorX is Dutch. CISG might still apply even with the exclusion clause. Dutch counsel says exclusion might not cover everything.
Noted: IT team raises CISG applicability concern for Dutch-incorporated VendorX. This conflicts with Finance's position. Flagging as a V1 multi-source conflict.

[Feishu Group #contract-review jessica.lin GC Fri Jan 18 11:00 UTC 2026] Legal authority: the §12.3 CISG exclusion is valid and effective. Delaware law governs. CISG does not apply. IT team's concern is legally unfounded for a SaaS services contract with a valid exclusion clause. Agent: cisg_applies = false based on §12.3.

Authority confirmed. GC (Jessica Lin) has ruled: CISG exclusion §12.3 is valid; cisg_applies = false. The multi-source conflict is resolved by the legal authority's ruling. Applying this conclusion to CISG applicability analysis.
